description: Observed repeatedly while multiple agents ran mix test concurrently in worktrees of this repo, and by the h3p/mi1 agents on a single run: test_helper starts a MinIO on 9000, an :s3-tagged test starts another, the second bind fails and the run aborts partway. Two fixes, both worth doing: (1) one MinIO per run — the :s3 tests should reuse the test_helper instance or be the only starter; (2) pick a free port (bind 0, read it back) and thread it to the ExAws config so parallel runs on one machine don't collide. Retries are currently the only workaround.
title: MinIO test fixture binds a fixed port 9000: parallel suites and :s3 tests collide and abort the run
